title: Tenma Saki — Fun, Happy Music〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I took care of everything on my to-do list just for this day! I even finished all my homework early! Sometimes I impress even myself!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And now, I'm all set and ready to go!
I couldn't be in better condition for this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know we're just watching my music video on the TV together, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense! We're talking about a music video starring my dear little sister! There is no way that I'm going to miss it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're that excited about seeing it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'm glad I asked you to join me♪ Let's get to it, then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll play it now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it takes place at a school!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! The theme revolves around youth, which suits us perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see. This does seem like the best way to visually represent your song!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki, there you are!
Hmm... Interesting...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, why'd you pause it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, pardon me! I couldn't help but notice your superb acting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The way you looked around, smiled and laughed felt incredibly natural!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
That was actually kinda hard.
You should've seen how robotic I was at first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then they filmed me chatting with Ichi and the others, who were off camera, and it turned out really well♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. A trick specific to music videos with no lines, I imagine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I apologize for pausing it.
Let's continue!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika seems different compared to normal. She has an air of calmness and maturity to her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She was asked to act all cool and grown-up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She was really worried she wouldn't get it right.
But she did such a good job!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm impressed! Her portrayal of this character is simply marvelous!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, why'd you pause it again?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The way you walked into the classroom and started talking to Ichika...! That was magnificent, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite not having any lines, the expression on your face makes it so clear that you're doing your best to cheer up your friend!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks.
But the best part's actually about to come up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, my apologies!
In that case, let's endeavor to watch it all the way through without any further pauses!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, what happened to no more pauses?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm incredibly sorry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you need to let me talk about this current scene, Saki! I know I said I'd stop pausing, but I'll have to rewind this part!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Argh! Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that was an excellent music video!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As it should be, considering you're the sister of a future star! Without question, you stole the show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes me really happy! I asked you for a lot of help when we did our other one, so I tried really hard on my own for this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Figuring how which expressions to make and how to move was really hard, but it was also an interesting process.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, it's wonderful to hear that you enjoyed acting to this extent...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. To be fair, all I did was dip my toes in.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I'm glad to hear that you enjoyed this experience! I couldn't be happier as a stage actor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes. Yes, I'm happy...
That feeling is genuine, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I admire the way you took on this challenge all by yourself, but... I wouldn't have minded helping you a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When it comes to acting, at least, I can perhaps still be of some assistance to you, you know? Yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure that we're gonna shoot more videos in the future, so I'll be sure to ask you if I ever get stuck!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, please do!
I promise to answer any questions that you bring to me! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa.
